reason: The README clearly describes a session hub that aggregates and routes remote DSH sessions and selectively imports local coding-agent histories into the official Web UI; it also documents SSH networking and optional credential synchronization, warranting R2 risk.

summaries.zh: 会话枢纽将配置的远程 DSH 会话和经授权导入的本地编码助手历史聚合到官方 Web UI 中，并支持跨服务器会话操作。
summaries.en: A session hub that aggregates configured remote DSH sessions and authorized local coding-agent histories in the official Web UI, with cross-server session operations.

capabilities: Aggregates sessions from configured remote DSH servers through API connections
Routes remote session operations such as creation, messaging, cancellation, renaming, archiving, and deletion
Optionally maintains SSH tunnels and reconnects to configured servers
Reads selected local Codex CLI, Claude Code, opencode, and Pi session logs when explicitly imported
Stores imported-session metadata and plugin configuration locally
Optionally reads local model credential references and writes missing model credentials to configured remote servers
Displays remote and imported session histories and live events in the host Web UI
